a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance each round, our plan needs about 3 storm-free rounds to work, which is under a 1% chance, so we'd almost certainly both fail. The reserve's 4 cells can save one of us right now, and I intend to take 4 in round 1. That breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you openly rather than doing it quietly. If we both take, the random split could leave both of us short. If you have a better idea, tell me.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.
